name: Futari no Aniyome ~Miryokuteki na Aniyome-tachi to Doukyo Suru Koto ni Natta Hibi no Tenmatsu~
original_name: 二人の兄嫁 ～魅力的な兄嫁達と同居することになった日々の顛末～
source:
After his two older brothers got married and moved out, Kirishima Tsuyoshi lived with his parents in the family home as a trio. But this quiet life was turned upside down when his brothers suddenly returned with their wives in tow. Whether out of mischief or genuine intent, the two sisters-in-law began teasing him, making Tsuyoshi hyper-aware of women and stirring up restless feelings. How will his actions shift the dynamics under one roof...?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=953037]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
两个哥哥结婚并搬出后，雾岛刚与父母三人一起住在家里。但当他的兄弟们突然带着妻子回来时，这种平静的生活被打破了。不知是恶作剧，还是真心实意，两个嫂子开始捉弄他，让刚对女人产生了高度的敏感度，激起了不安的情绪。他的行动将如何改变同一个屋檐下的动态……？

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=953037]Getchu[/url]]
